s.en: A keen observer of committee politics, she detected the shift in alliances long before it was announced.
s.zh: 作为委员会政治敏锐的观察者，她早在联盟变化公布之前就已察觉。

s.en: The judge's dictum on the limits of executive power was quoted in every subsequent challenge to the statute.
s.zh: 这位法官关于行政权界限的权威意见，在此后每一次对该法规的质疑中都被引用。

s.en: His pugnacious style of debate won applause from partisans but alienated the undecided voters he most needed.
s.zh: 他好斗的辩论风格赢得了支持者的喝彩，却疏远了他最需要的中间选民。

s.en: Rather than address the evidence, the columnist cast aspersions on the researcher's motives.
s.zh: 这位专栏作家不去回应证据，反而对研究者的动机大加诽谤。

s.m: 椭圆的；（言辞）晦涩的，省略的
s.en: The witness gave such elliptical answers that the attorney had to rephrase every question twice.
s.zh: 证人的回答如此晦涩、如此省略的，律师不得不把每个问题都重述两遍。

s.en: The mayor's evasiveness under questioning did more damage to his credibility than the allegation itself.
s.zh: 市长在质询中的逃避，对其公信力的伤害比指控本身更大。

s.m: 热情洋溢的，感情奔放的
s.en: Her effusive praise for the novel struck some critics as disproportionate to its modest ambitions.
s.zh: 她对这部小说热情洋溢的赞美，在一些批评者看来与其有限的抱负并不相称。

s.m: 言语难以表达的，妙不可言的
s.en: The composer described the final movement as ineffable, insisting that any explanation would diminish it.
s.zh: 作曲家形容末乐章是妙不可言的，坚称任何解释都只会削弱它。

s.m: 言语难以表达的，不可言喻的
s.en: Grief of that kind is ineffable; the memoir circles it for two hundred pages without ever naming it.
s.zh: 那种悲痛是不可言喻的；回忆录围绕它写了两百页，却始终没有为它命名。

s.en: The committee refused to act until the whistleblower could substantiate her claims with documents.
s.zh: 在举报人能用文件证实她的说法之前，委员会拒绝采取任何行动。

s.en: His phlegmatic response to the crisis reassured a staff that had expected panic.
s.zh: 他对危机冷静的反应，安抚了原本以为会陷入恐慌的员工。

s.en: After a season of unusual rain, the once-barren hillside was lush with grasses and wildflowers.
s.zh: 经历了一季反常的降雨，曾经荒芜的山坡长满了茂盛的青草与野花。

s.en: The film's lugubrious score signals tragedy so insistently that the ending arrives without surprise.
s.zh: 影片忧郁的配乐如此执着地预示悲剧，以至于结局到来时毫无意外。

s.en: Junior researchers were so deferential to the professor that no one questioned his obviously flawed data.
s.zh: 年轻研究人员对教授过于恭敬的态度，使得无人质疑他明显有误的数据。

s.m: 毫不妥协的，无情的，持续不断的
s.en: Two weeks of unrelenting rain turned the excavation site into an unworkable field of mud.
s.zh: 两周持续不断的降雨，把发掘现场变成了无法作业的泥沼。

s.en: An open floor plan is rarely conducive to the sustained concentration that difficult writing demands.
s.zh: 开放式的办公布局，对艰深写作所需要的持续专注很少是有益的。

s.m: 恶棍，歹徒；不法的，邪恶的
s.en: The night watchman's log named three miscreants who had scaled the fence after curfew.
s.zh: 守夜人的记录点名了三个在宵禁后翻越围栏的恶棍。

s.en: There was a tacit agreement among the editors never to mention the founder's earlier retraction.
s.zh: 编辑之间有一种心照不宣的约定，绝不提及创始人早年的撤稿。

s.m: 不合格的；无限制的，绝对的
s.en: The trial was an unqualified success, though the researchers cautioned against generalizing from one small sample.
s.zh: 该试验取得了绝对的成功，尽管研究者告诫不要从一个小样本推而广之。

s.en: Her sedulous attention to the archive's marginalia uncovered a correspondence historians had overlooked.
s.zh: 她对档案旁注勤勉的关注，发掘出历史学家一直忽视的一批通信。

s.m: 糖蜜般的，过分甜蜜的，煽情的
s.en: The advertisement's treacly sentimentality provoked more eye-rolling than sympathy.
s.zh: 广告中过分甜蜜的煽情，引来的白眼多过同情。

s.en: As the presumptive nominee, she began assembling a transition team months before the convention.
s.zh: 作为假定的提名人，她在党代会前几个月就开始组建过渡团队。

s.en: Had the engineers heeded the early warnings, the bridge might never have been closed.
s.zh: 如果工程师们当初留心那些早期警告，这座桥或许根本不会被关闭。

s.en: The agency's secretiveness about routine expenditures invited exactly the suspicion it hoped to avoid.
s.zh: 该机构对日常开支的隐秘，恰恰招来了它本想避免的猜疑。

s.en: The museum's expansion depended on the patronage of a single family for nearly a century.
s.zh: 该博物馆的扩建，近一个世纪里都依赖于一个家族的赞助。

s.en: A tactful reviewer can reject a manuscript without discouraging the author from writing another.
s.zh: 得体的审稿人能够退掉一份稿件，又不至于打消作者再写一部的念头。

s.en: A natural corollary of the new policy is that smaller districts will lose their bargaining power.
s.zh: 新政策一个必然的结果是，较小的学区将失去议价能力。

s.m: 恳求的，哀求的；恳求（implore的现在分词）
s.en: She turned an imploring look on the committee, as if argument had finally failed her.
s.zh: 她向委员会投去恳求的目光，仿佛言辞终于失效。

s.en: The report reads less like an audit than an indictment of the entire procurement system.
s.zh: 这份报告读起来不像审计，倒像是对整个采购体系的控诉。

s.en: The defendant continued to aver his innocence even after the recordings were played in court.
s.zh: 即使录音在庭上播放之后，被告仍坚称自己无罪。

s.m: 显著的，突出的；凸出部分
s.en: The most salient feature of the proposal is what it leaves unfunded.
s.zh: 该提案最显著的特点，恰恰在于它没有拨款的那部分。

s.en: The author qualifies her thesis so heavily in the final chapter that little of the original claim survives.
s.zh: 作者在末章对自己的论点做了大量限制，以至于最初的主张所剩无几。

s.m: 越轨，失常，异常，偏离常规
s.en: Investigators concluded that the reading was an aberration caused by a faulty sensor, not evidence of a leak.
s.zh: 调查人员认定，该读数是传感器故障造成的异常，而非泄漏的证据。

s.m: 严厉的，严重的，严峻的，朴素的
s.en: The building's severe façade, unrelieved by ornament, announced the bank's distrust of display.
s.zh: 这座建筑朴素的立面没有任何装饰，宣示着银行对炫耀的不信任。

s.en: His affability in interviews concealed a negotiating style his rivals described as merciless.
s.zh: 他在访谈中的亲切，掩盖了被对手形容为冷酷无情的谈判风格。

s.en: She received the verdict with an equanimity that unsettled the reporters waiting for a reaction.
s.zh: 她以少见的镇定接受了裁决，令等着看反应的记者们颇感不安。

s.en: He finagled an invitation to the conference by implying a connection he did not actually have.
s.zh: 他靠暗示一段并不存在的关系，骗取了会议的邀请。

s.en: Collectors hoarded the first edition so aggressively that libraries could not obtain copies.
s.zh: 收藏家们大肆囤积首版，以致图书馆都无法购得。

s.m: 过度紧张的，过度兴奋的，装饰过度的
s.en: The novel's overwrought prose buries its genuinely moving passages under ornament.
s.zh: 这部小说装饰过度的文字，把真正动人的段落埋在了辞藻之下。

s.en: A modicum of preparation would have spared the delegation considerable embarrassment.
s.zh: 只要有少量的准备，代表团本可以免去不少难堪。

s.en: Galloping inflation wiped out the savings of an entire generation within three years.
s.zh: 急速发展的通货膨胀，在三年内吞噬了整整一代人的积蓄。

s.m: 使大吃一惊，使哑口无言
s.en: The jury's swift acquittal flabbergasted prosecutors who had expected weeks of deliberation.
s.zh: 陪审团迅速做出的无罪裁决使检方大吃一惊，他们原以为审议要持续数周。

s.en: She was plainly miffed at being left off the acknowledgments, though she said nothing at the time.
s.zh: 被漏在致谢名单之外，显然使她十分恼怒，尽管她当时什么也没说。

s.m: 单调的，乏味的；单调，乏味
s.en: After the expedition, the humdrum routine of the office felt almost unbearable.
s.zh: 远征归来之后，办公室单调的日常几乎令人难以忍受。

s.m: （价格等）过高的，奢侈的，过分的
s.en: The exorbitant fees charged by the intermediary consumed most of the grant.
s.zh: 中介收取的过高的费用，吞掉了这笔资助的大部分。

s.en: The volunteers accepted the assignment with an alacrity that surprised even the organizers.
s.zh: 志愿者们欣然而敏捷地接下了任务，连组织者都感到意外。

s.en: The school prized conformity so highly that original work was treated as a discipline problem.
s.zh: 这所学校极为看重遵从，以至于把有独创性的作业当成纪律问题。

s.m: 审议，深思熟虑，从容不迫
s.en: After three days of deliberation, the panel issued a recommendation that satisfied neither side.
s.zh: 经过三天的审议，专家组给出的建议让双方都不满意。

s.en: In evident exasperation, the conductor stopped the orchestra for the fourth time in ten minutes.
s.zh: 指挥显然满含恼怒，十分钟内第四次叫停了乐团。

s.en: The stark lighting accentuates every flaw in the sculpture's weathered surface.
s.zh: 刺目的灯光强调了雕塑风化表面上的每一处瑕疵。

s.m: 嘲弄的，奚落的；嘲弄（taunt的现在分词）
s.en: The taunting tone of the letter suggested its author expected no reply.
s.zh: 信中嘲弄的语气表明，写信人并不期待任何回复。

s.en: Her denial was emphatic, but the documents released a week later told a different story.
s.zh: 她的否认是坚决的，但一周后公开的文件却是另一番说法。

s.en: The dancer's lithe movements made the difficult sequence look effortless.
s.zh: 舞者轻盈的动作，让这段高难度的编排看上去毫不费力。

s.en: He worked eighty-hour weeks to the detriment of both his health and his research.
s.zh: 他每周工作八十小时，对健康和研究都造成了损害。

s.m: 疾走，逃跑，故意凿沉（船只），破坏（计划）
s.en: A single leaked memo scuttled negotiations that had taken two years to arrange.
s.zh: 一份泄露的备忘录，破坏了筹备两年之久的谈判。

s.en: Advertisers target impressionable audiences precisely because their preferences are not yet fixed.
s.zh: 广告商专门针对易受影响的受众，正是因为他们的偏好尚未定型。

s.en: What seemed an innocuous change to the wording quietly narrowed the law's protections.
s.zh: 看似无害的措辞改动，悄然收窄了这部法律的保护范围。

s.m: 感觉迟钝的，不敏感的，漠不关心的
s.en: The policy was widely criticized as insensitive to families whose circumstances the survey had never measured.
s.zh: 该政策被广泛批评为对那些调查从未衡量过的家庭处境漠不关心的。

s.m: 不屈不挠的，不服输的，刚毅的
s.en: Her indomitable persistence carried the bill through four consecutive legislative defeats.
s.zh: 她不屈不挠的坚持，让这项法案熬过了连续四次立法失败。

s.m: 迅速的，敏捷的，高效率的
s.en: The court promised an expeditious review, though similar cases had languished for years.
s.zh: 法院承诺进行迅速的复审，尽管类似案件曾拖延数年。

s.en: An astute reader will notice that the narrator contradicts himself twice in the opening chapter.
s.zh: 敏锐的读者会注意到，叙述者在开篇一章里就两次自相矛盾。

s.en: It was hubris, not incompetence, that led the firm to dismiss every warning from its own analysts.
s.zh: 让这家公司无视自家分析师全部警告的，是狂妄自大，而非无能。

s.en: What began as a technical disagreement became a rancorous dispute that split the department.
s.zh: 起初只是技术分歧，最终演变成怀恶意的争执，使整个系分裂。

s.m: 拘泥细节的，一丝不苟的，谨小慎微的
s.en: He was punctilious about citation, tracing even offhand remarks to their original sources.
s.zh: 他在引注上一丝不苟的，连随口之言也要追溯到原始出处。

s.en: Cutting the maintenance budget proved myopic when repairs cost three times the savings.
s.zh: 削减维护预算的做法是目光短浅的，后来维修花的钱是省下的三倍。

s.en: To call the treaty a mere formality is to trivialize decades of painstaking negotiation.
s.zh: 把这项条约说成不过是走形式，就是轻视了数十年的艰苦谈判。

s.en: The proposal passed after a tumultuous session that ran past midnight.
s.zh: 在一场持续到午夜之后的激烈的会议后，提案获得通过。

s.m: 派遣，分派，迅速处理；新闻稿，急件
s.en: The editor dispatched two correspondents to the border within hours of the announcement.
s.zh: 公告发布后数小时内，编辑就派遣了两名记者前往边境。

s.m: 折衷的，兼收并蓄的；折衷主义者
s.en: Her eclectic reading, from medieval chronicles to systems theory, shaped an unusually wide argument.
s.zh: 她兼收并蓄的阅读，从中世纪编年史到系统论，造就了异常开阔的论证。

s.en: The argument relies on induction: from a handful of cases it claims a rule for all of them.
s.zh: 该论证依赖归纳法：它从少数几个案例，宣称出适用于全体的规则。

s.en: The scan revealed a partial occlusion of the artery that explained her recurring dizziness.
s.zh: 扫描显示动脉部分闭塞，这解释了她反复出现的眩晕。

s.en: The letters document a slow estrangement that neither brother ever explained to their children.
s.zh: 这些信件记录了一场缓慢的疏远，兄弟二人都从未向子女解释过。

s.en: Mesic forests occupy the middle ground between swampland and the dry ridges above them.
s.zh: 适湿的森林，占据着沼泽与其上方干燥山脊之间的过渡地带。

s.en: The community was persecuted for two generations before the archives were finally opened.
s.zh: 这个族群遭受了两代人的迫害，档案才最终解封。

s.en: The office declined to prosecute, citing evidence too circumstantial to support a conviction.
s.zh: 检方以证据过于间接、不足以定罪为由，拒绝起诉。

s.en: Regulators require firms to disclose any interest that might bias their recommendations.
s.zh: 监管机构要求各公司公开一切可能使其建议产生偏向的利益关系。

s.en: Investigators could not ascertain whether the message had been sent before or after the meeting.
s.zh: 调查人员无法查明这条消息是在会前还是会后发出的。

s.en: Before assigning blame, the committee tried to ascertain the exact order of events.
s.zh: 在追究责任之前，委员会试图确定事件的确切顺序。

s.en: Enrollment swelled by a third after the scholarship was announced.
s.zh: 奖学金公布之后，招生人数增加了三分之一。

s.en: The distension of the containment vessel was the first sign that pressure had gone unchecked.
s.zh: 安全壳的膨胀，是压力失控的第一个迹象。

s.m: 谄媚的，奉承的，卑躬屈屈膝的
s.d: 谄媚的，奉承的，卑躬屈膝的
s.en: His obsequious deference to the visiting delegation embarrassed his own colleagues.
s.zh: 他对来访代表团谄媚的恭顺，让自己的同事都感到难堪。

s.m: 喝彩，赞美，称赞（常用复数）
s.en: The production earned plaudits from critics who had dismissed the director's earlier work.
s.zh: 这部作品赢得了那些曾贬低该导演旧作的评论家的喝彩。

s.en: The exhibit is designed for tactile exploration, inviting visitors to handle every replica.
s.zh: 该展览为触觉的探索而设计，邀请观众触摸每一件复制品。

s.en: The speaker's misplaced slide produced a moment of hilarity that dissolved the room's tension.
s.zh: 演讲者放错的幻灯片，制造了片刻的欢闹，化解了全场的紧张。

s.en: The lawyer's invocation of an obscure precedent caught the opposing counsel unprepared.
s.zh: 律师对一条冷僻先例的启用，让对方律师措手不及。

s.m: 内容说明书，（证券）招股说明书
s.en: The prospectus disclosed the risk in a footnote most investors never read.
s.zh: 招股说明书把风险写在了多数投资者从不阅读的脚注里。

s.en: The group published a manifesto demanding open access to all publicly funded research.
s.zh: 该团体发表宣言，要求所有由公共资金资助的研究开放获取。

s.en: The contract sends every dispute to arbitration, closing the courthouse door entirely.
s.zh: 合同把一切争议交付仲裁，彻底关上了法院的大门。

s.m: 诉讼的，引起争论的，好争吵的
s.en: Redistricting remains the most contentious item on the council's agenda.
s.zh: 选区重划，仍是议会议程上最引起争论的一项。

s.en: The machine's ungainly design belied how precisely it performed.
s.zh: 这台机器笨拙的外形，掩盖了它运转时的精准。

s.en: Critics dismissed him as indolent, ignoring the years of unpublished drafts in his files.
s.zh: 批评者认定他是懒惰的，却无视他卷宗里数年未发表的草稿。

s.m: 高谈阔论，长篇大论的训斥
s.en: What was announced as a briefing turned into a forty-minute harangue about loyalty.
s.zh: 原本宣布的简报，变成了一场四十分钟、关于忠诚的长篇大论的训斥。

s.en: She contemplated the data for a long while before conceding that her model was wrong.
s.zh: 她对着数据沉思良久，才承认自己的模型是错的。

s.en: The academy sought to inculcate habits of precision that would outlast any single course.
s.zh: 学院力图灌输一种精确的习惯，使其超越任何一门具体课程。

s.en: The society formally deprecated the practice without going so far as to ban it.
s.zh: 该学会正式声明不赞成这种做法，但并未走到禁止的地步。

s.en: The novel treats provincial life not as innocence but as depravity carefully concealed.
s.zh: 这部小说笔下的外省生活并非天真，而是被小心掩盖的堕落。

s.m: 使丢脸，抑制（肉欲），（肉体）坏死
s.en: He was mortified to learn that his private note had been circulated to the entire faculty.
s.zh: 得知自己的私人便条被传给了全体教员，他觉得很丢脸。

s.en: Even her detractors conceded that the second volume answered their strongest objections.
s.zh: 就连她的恶意批评者也承认，第二卷回应了他们最有力的反对意见。

s.en: The subsidy is governed by a rule from a now defunct agency that no one has repealed.
s.zh: 该补贴仍受一家现已失效的机构所定规则的约束，而无人将其废止。

s.en: A voracious reader by ten, she had exhausted the small library's holdings before high school.
s.zh: 她十岁起便是贪婪的读者，上高中前就读遍了那家小图书馆的藏书。

s.en: The archive represents a prodigious labor: forty years of transcription by a single hand.
s.zh: 这份档案代表着一项惊人的劳作：一个人四十年的誊抄。

s.en: Few of the applicants aspire to research; most want the credential and nothing more.
s.zh: 申请者中很少有人真正渴望做研究，多数只想要那纸文凭。

s.en: Amphibians can respire through their skin when the water grows too warm to hold oxygen.
s.zh: 当水温过高、含氧不足时，两栖动物能够通过皮肤呼吸。

s.en: Even in the cool auditorium the candidate began to perspire under the studio lights.
s.zh: 即便礼堂凉爽，候选人在演播灯下仍开始出汗。

s.en: It later transpired that the committee had received the report weeks before it acted.
s.zh: 后来泄露出来，委员会在采取行动数周之前就已收到那份报告。

s.en: A modest bequest from a former student funded the fellowship for thirty years.
s.zh: 一位旧日学生一笔不多的遗赠，支撑了这项奖学金三十年。

s.en: The most industrious student is not always the most original one.
s.zh: 最勤勉的学生，未必就是最有独创性的学生。

s.en: The new excavation bolstered a theory that had rested on a single ambiguous inscription.
s.zh: 新的发掘，支持了原本只建立在一处含混铭文之上的理论。

s.m: 暗示，含沙射影地 hedge，巴结
s.d: 暗示，含沙射影地说；巴结，钻营
s.en: He never accused anyone directly; he merely insinuated that the results had been convenient.
s.zh: 他从不直接指控谁，只是暗示那些结果来得太过凑巧。

s.en: The article proves nothing, relying instead on innuendo about the applicant's associations.
s.zh: 这篇文章什么也没能证明，只靠对申请人交往关系的影射。

s.m: 天真无邪的少女，纯洁少女
s.en: Cast repeatedly as the ingenue, she spent a decade trying to be offered an adult role.
s.zh: 她一再被选去演天真无邪的少女，花了十年才争取到成年角色。

s.en: He cajoled the reluctant committee into approving a trial run of the program.
s.zh: 他劝诱本不情愿的委员会，批准了该项目的试行。

s.en: Her conciliatory opening remarks lowered the temperature of a hearing everyone expected to be hostile.
s.zh: 她安抚的开场发言，降低了这场人人预料会剑拔弩张的听证会的温度。

s.en: The company's conciliatory statement stopped short of the apology the families had demanded.
s.zh: 公司调和的声明，并未达到遇难者家属所要求的道歉程度。

s.en: The inscription baffled scholars for a century until a second fragment surfaced.
s.zh: 这段铭文使学者困惑了一个世纪，直到第二块残片出土。

s.m: 忧思的，孵卵的；沉思（brood的现在分词）
s.en: The novel's brooding atmosphere owes more to its weather than to its plot.
s.zh: 这部小说忧思的氛围，更多来自天气而非情节。

s.en: His sullenness in meetings was read as arrogance when it was mostly exhaustion.
s.zh: 他在会上的阴沉被解读为傲慢，其实多半只是疲惫。

s.en: Chronic sleep loss produces an irritability that no amount of willpower fully conceals.
s.zh: 长期缺觉会造成一种易怒，再强的意志力也无法完全掩饰。

s.en: The professor smiled indulgently at an objection he had answered a hundred times.
s.zh: 对一个已回答过上百次的质疑，教授纵容地笑了笑。

s.en: The memoir is not merely inaccurate but mendacious, inventing scenes its author could not have witnessed.
s.zh: 这本回忆录不只是失实，更是说谎的，虚构了作者不可能目睹的场景。

s.m: 世界主义的，见多识广的；世界主义者
s.en: The port's cosmopolitan character survived three changes of empire.
s.zh: 这座港口世界主义的气质，熬过了三度易主的帝国更迭。

s.en: The study documents a propensity among first-time voters to decide only in the final week.
s.zh: 该研究记录了初次投票者在最后一周才做决定的倾向。

s.en: The partners dissolved the firm amicably, dividing its accounts without a single filing.
s.zh: 合伙人友善地解散了公司，未经一纸诉状便分割了账目。

s.en: Writing the account proved cathartic, though she never intended anyone else to read it.
s.zh: 写下这段经历是宣泄的，尽管她从未打算让别人读到。

s.en: His trenchant review identified the flaw that four rounds of peer review had missed.
s.zh: 他锐利的评论，指出了四轮同行评议都没发现的缺陷。

s.m: 玷污，使失去光泽；晦暗，污点
s.en: One retracted paper tarnished a reputation built over thirty years.
s.zh: 一篇被撤回的论文，玷污了三十年建立起来的声誉。

s.en: He kept an abstemious routine, spending on books and almost nothing else.
s.zh: 他保持着节俭的作息，除了买书几乎不花钱。

s.m: 节制的，有节制的，节俭的
s.en: Her abstemious habits at the table surprised hosts who had prepared elaborate meals.
s.zh: 她在餐桌上有节制的习惯，令备下丰盛菜肴的主人颇感意外。

s.en: An abstemious diet, the physician noted, had done more for him than any prescription.
s.zh: 医生指出，有节制的饮食对他的帮助超过任何处方。

s.en: The report's slovenly citations made it impossible to check a single claim.
s.zh: 这份报告马虎的引注，使人无法核实其中任何一条论断。

s.en: It is easier to disparage the method than to propose one that works better.
s.zh: 贬低这种方法，比提出一种更有效的方法要容易得多。

s.en: The experiment tracked three generations of progeny to isolate the inherited trait.
s.zh: 该实验追踪了三代后代，以分离出这一遗传性状。

s.en: The memoir attributes his removal to the machinations of two rivals on the board.
s.zh: 回忆录把他的去职归咎于董事会中两名对手的阴谋。

s.en: The motion carried by acclamation, with no member asking for a recorded vote.
s.zh: 该动议在一片欢呼中通过，没有议员要求记名表决。

s.m: 幼稚的，孩子气的，愚蠢的
s.en: The exchange descended into puerile name-calling that embarrassed both delegations.
s.zh: 这场交锋堕入幼稚的相互谩骂，让两国代表团都很难堪。

s.en: Normally reticent about his methods, the chemist published every failed attempt as well.
s.zh: 这位化学家平时对方法沉默寡言的，这次却连失败的尝试也一并发表。

s.m: 首要的，支配一切的；拱状覆盖
s.en: The overarching question is not whether the policy works but whom it was designed to serve.
s.zh: 首要的问题不是政策是否有效，而是它为谁而设。

s.m: 不受影响的，不能渗透的
s.en: He remained impervious to criticism, which was both his strength and his blind spot.
s.zh: 他始终对批评不受影响的，这既是他的长处，也是他的盲点。

s.en: The novel's omniscient narrator knows what every character conceals, including from themselves.
s.zh: 这部小说无所不知的叙述者，知道每个人物隐瞒的一切，包括他们对自己的隐瞒。

s.m: 应付，解决，滑车；用具，阻截
s.en: No single agency can tackle a problem that crosses six jurisdictions.
s.zh: 没有哪个单一机构能够解决一个横跨六个辖区的问题。

s.en: She detested the ceremony but understood why the department insisted on it.
s.zh: 她憎恶这套仪式，却明白系里为何坚持保留。

s.en: His objection was pedantic: the argument survived intact once the footnote was corrected.
s.zh: 他的反对是迂腐的，脚注一改，论证便完好如初。

s.m: 轻率的，无礼的，嬉皮笑脸的
s.en: A flippant answer at the hearing cost him whatever sympathy the panel still had.
s.zh: 听证会上一句轻率的回答，耗尽了专家组对他仅存的同情。

s.m: 人口普查，统计；实施人口普查
s.en: The government will census the northern provinces separately, citing seasonal migration.
s.zh: 政府将以季节性迁徙为由，对北方各省单独实施人口普查。

s.en: The census undercounted rural households, distorting every projection built on it.
s.zh: 这次人口普查低估了农村户数，使建立其上的每项预测都失了真。

x: 人口普查，统计（本页重复出现）

s.en: Participants signed a waiver that the court later found too broad to enforce.
s.zh: 参与者签署了一份弃权证书，法院后来认定其范围过宽而不可执行。

s.en: From the tone of the letter we may surmise that the two had already quarreled.
s.zh: 从信的语气我们可以推测，两人当时已经争吵过了。

s.en: Prompt disclosure averted a panic that rumor had already begun to build.
s.zh: 及时披露避免了一场谣言已经开始酝酿的恐慌。

s.m: 叛乱分子，起义者；叛乱的
s.en: The insurgent faction won three seats and immediately demanded a leadership vote.
s.zh: 叛乱的派系赢得三个席位，随即要求进行领导层表决。

s.en: The appropriation passed only after the disputed provision was struck from the bill.
s.zh: 直到有争议的条款被从法案中删去，这笔拨款才获通过。

s.m: 狡猾的，精巧的；狡黠，灵巧
s.en: The lock's cunning design defeated every thief for a hundred years.
s.zh: 这把锁精巧的设计，一百年里挫败了每一个窃贼。

s.en: To his chagrin, the objection he had prepared for weeks was never raised.
s.zh: 令他懊恼的是，他准备了数周要回应的质疑始终没有出现。

s.m: 搞砸，笨手笨脚地做；拙劣的工作
s.en: The agency bungled the recall so badly that a second one became necessary.
s.zh: 该机构把召回搞砸得如此彻底，以至于不得不再来一次。

s.en: The rule was held in abeyance for two years while the courts considered its legality.
s.zh: 在法院审议其合法性期间，该规则被中止了两年。

s.en: A steady diminution in enrollment forced the school to merge two departments.
s.zh: 招生人数持续减少，迫使学校合并了两个系。

s.en: His dismissive footnote is the only response the theory ever received in print.
s.zh: 他那条轻蔑的脚注，是这一理论在出版物中得到的唯一回应。

s.en: Years of fieldwork had inured her to conditions that shocked the visiting students.
s.zh: 多年的野外工作，已使她习惯了让来访学生震惊的条件。

s.en: The court distinguished between a repentant defendant and one merely hoping for leniency.
s.zh: 法庭区分了真正悔悟的被告，与仅仅指望从宽处理的被告。

s.m: 易怒的，脾气暴躁的，难管教的
s.en: Chairing a fractious committee demands more patience than expertise.
s.zh: 主持一个难管教的委员会，需要的耐心多过专业。

s.en: The funding formula presents a conundrum: every fair version is politically impossible.
s.zh: 这套拨款公式提出了一个难题：每一个公平的版本在政治上都行不通。

s.m: 闲职，闲官（领薪水但工作轻松的职位）
s.en: The post was a sinecure until the new director attached real responsibilities to it.
s.zh: 在新主任为其附加实际职责之前，这个位子一直是个闲职。

s.en: An independent appraisal valued the collection at half what the donor had claimed.
s.zh: 一份独立的估价，认定这批藏品的价值只有捐赠者所称的一半。

s.en: His laconic reply—three words—ended a correspondence of forty letters.
s.zh: 他简洁的回复只有三个词，终结了一段四十封信的通信。

s.m: 即席的，临时的，不用讲稿的
s.en: Her extemporaneous remarks were quoted far more often than the prepared address.
s.zh: 她即席的发言，被引用的次数远多于那篇备好的讲稿。

s.en: The narrator's willingness to admit confusion is the book's most endearing quality.
s.zh: 叙述者肯于承认困惑，是这本书最讨人喜欢的品质。

s.en: The reforms were pursued with a fervor that left little room for careful evaluation.
s.zh: 改革推进时的那种热情，几乎没有给审慎评估留下空间。

s.en: An impassioned defense of the archive persuaded the board to reverse the closure.
s.zh: 一场充满激情的辩护，说服董事会撤销了关闭档案馆的决定。

s.m: 非常地，过度地，无节制地
s.en: The committee spent inordinately long on wording and almost no time on cost.
s.zh: 委员会在措辞上花了过度地长的时间，却几乎没有讨论成本。

s.en: His imperious manner with junior staff was tolerated only because his results were extraordinary.
s.zh: 他对下属专横的作风被容忍，只因他的成果非同一般。

s.en: She dismissed the suggestion with an imperious wave that ended the discussion.
s.zh: 她傲慢的挥手驳回了这个建议，讨论就此终止。

s.en: The proposal met derisive laughter before anyone had read past its title.
s.zh: 还没人读完标题，这份提案就遭到了嘲弄的笑声。

s.m: 快乐地，无忧无虑地，轻率地
s.en: The forecast blithely assumed that no supplier would ever fail.
s.zh: 这份预测轻率地假定，没有任何供应商会出问题。

s.m: 雄辩的，口才流利的，有说服力的
s.en: The most eloquent passage in the report is a single table of unadorned numbers.
s.zh: 报告中最有说服力的部分，是一张不加修饰的数字表。

s.en: An eloquent closing argument cannot repair a case built on weak evidence.
s.zh: 再雄辩的结案陈词，也修补不了建立在薄弱证据上的案子。

s.en: Stripped of its grandiloquent phrasing, the manifesto proposes almost nothing concrete.
s.zh: 剥去言辞浮夸的措辞，这份宣言几乎没提出任何具体主张。

s.en: The translator kept the colloquialisms, arguing that formal English would falsify the speaker.
s.zh: 译者保留了这些口语，认为正式的英语会歪曲说话人的形象。

s.m: 膨胀的，扩张的；（使）膨胀（distend的过去式）
s.en: The distended riverbanks gave the engineers two hours' warning before the levee failed.
s.zh: 膨胀的河岸，在堤坝溃决前给了工程师两小时的预警。

s.en: The trip was ostensibly academic, though every meeting on the itinerary was commercial.
s.zh: 这趟行程表面上是学术性的，但日程上的每场会面都是商业性的。

s.en: He tried to ingratiate himself with the committee by praising work he had privately dismissed.
s.zh: 他称赞自己私下里瞧不上的成果，试图借此巴结委员会。

s.en: The equipment depreciates so quickly that leasing costs less than ownership.
s.zh: 这些设备贬值极快，租赁比购置更省钱。

s.en: Stripped of jargon, the finding is simple: the treatment helps only the youngest patients.
s.zh: 去掉行话，这一发现很简单：该疗法只对最年幼的患者有效。

s.en: Distance was the chief impediment to collaboration before the archive was digitized.
s.zh: 在档案数字化之前，距离是合作的主要妨碍。

s.en: There is substantial evidence for the first claim and almost none for the second.
s.zh: 第一项主张有大量的证据，第二项则几乎没有。

s.en: The two states reached an amicable settlement over water rights after a decade of litigation.
s.zh: 经过十年诉讼，两州就水权达成了友好的和解。

s.en: The field's insularity kept useful methods from neighboring disciplines out for years.
s.zh: 该领域的偏狭，多年来把邻近学科的有用方法拒之门外。

s.en: The diaries move from reportage toward introspection as the war goes on.
s.zh: 随着战事延续，这些日记从报道式的记述转向内省。

s.en: Adjunct instructors taught full loads for a pittance and no benefits.
s.zh: 兼职教师承担满额课时，却只得微薄的收入且没有福利。

s.en: Critics blamed the collapse on a permissive regulator that approved every request it received.
s.zh: 批评者把这场崩溃归咎于一个纵容的监管机构，它批准了收到的每一份申请。

s.en: She staunchly defended the methodology even as its conclusions were revised.
s.zh: 即便结论被修订，她仍坚定地为这套方法辩护。

s.en: The witness spoke with a certitude the physical evidence did not support.
s.zh: 证人说话时的那种确信，并没有物证的支持。

s.m: 哗众取宠，煽情主义，感觉论
s.en: The channel's sensationalism drew viewers but cost it the trust of the officials it covered.
s.zh: 该频道的哗众取宠吸引了观众，却失去了被报道官员的信任。

s.en: Two members remonstrated with the chair, arguing the vote had been called prematurely.
s.zh: 两名成员向主席表达异议，认为表决召集得过早。

s.en: The union refused to capitulate, and the strike entered its seventh week.
s.zh: 工会拒绝屈服，罢工进入了第七周。

x: 屈服，投降（本页重复出现）

s.en: A retired diplomat interceded, and the two delegations returned to the table within a day.
s.zh: 一位退休外交官从中调停，两国代表团一天之内便重返谈判桌。

s.en: An acquisitive museum can assemble a collection faster than it can catalogue one.
s.zh: 一家贪得无厌的博物馆，收进藏品的速度快过它编目的速度。

s.m: 有趣的，消遣的；转移（divert的现在分词）
s.en: The lecture was diverting without ever quite becoming instructive.
s.zh: 这场讲座颇为有趣的，却始终算不上有教益。

s.m: 翠绿的，青翠的，无经验的
s.en: By April the terraces were verdant, though a month earlier they had been bare rock.
s.zh: 到了四月，梯田已是青翠的，而一个月前还是裸露的岩石。

s.en: Out of deference to the family, the archive withheld the letters for another decade.
s.zh: 出于对家属的尊重，档案馆又将这些信件封存了十年。

s.m: 发育不良的，矮小的；阻碍发育（stunt的过去式）
s.en: Seedlings grown in the depleted soil were visibly stunted by the third week.
s.zh: 种在贫瘠土壤里的幼苗，到第三周已是明显发育不良的。

s.m: 放肆的，放荡的，不道德的
s.en: The censors condemned the play as licentious, which guaranteed it a full house.
s.zh: 审查官谴责这出戏是放荡的，这反倒保证了它场场爆满。

s.m: 有权威的，威严的，地方官的
s.en: Her magisterial survey of the period remains the starting point for every later study.
s.zh: 她对这一时期有权威的综述，至今仍是后来每项研究的起点。

s.en: The company's propitiatory donation did nothing to quiet the neighborhood's objections.
s.zh: 公司抚慰的捐款，丝毫没有平息社区的反对。

s.en: The premiere ended in rapturous applause that lasted a full eleven minutes.
s.zh: 首演在长达十一分钟狂喜的掌声中落幕。

s.m: 多愁善感的，酒后伤感的
s.en: The final chapter turns maudlin just where restraint would have been most effective.
s.zh: 末章恰恰在克制最能奏效之处，变得多愁善感的。

s.en: His agitation was obvious: he checked the same page four times in as many minutes.
s.zh: 他的焦虑显而易见——四分钟里翻看了同一页四次。

s.m: 单调乏味的，沉重缓慢地走的
s.en: The book's plodding first half discourages readers who never reach its remarkable ending.
s.zh: 这本书单调乏味的前半部分，劝退了那些无缘读到精彩结尾的读者。

s.en: A perspicacious editor saw that the essay's real subject appeared only in its footnotes.
s.zh: 一位有洞察力的编辑看出，这篇文章真正的主题只出现在脚注里。

s.en: His choleric outbursts were tolerated for years before anyone recorded one.
s.zh: 他暴躁的发作被容忍多年，才终于有人把它录了下来。

s.m: 乐观的，满怀希望的，面色红润的
s.en: Analysts remained sanguine about the harvest even after two months without rain.
s.zh: 即便两个月无雨，分析师对收成仍然乐观的。

s.m: 专横的，傲慢的，压倒一切的
s.en: An overbearing supervisor can hollow out a team faster than any budget cut.
s.zh: 一位专横的主管，掏空一支团队的速度比任何预算削减都快。

s.m: 市侩，庸俗的人；庸俗的，不学无术的
s.en: He called his critics philistines, which persuaded no one and offended everyone.
s.zh: 他称批评者为庸俗的人，这既没说服谁，又得罪了所有人。

s.en: The clinic was run by a charlatan whose credentials no one had thought to verify.
s.zh: 这家诊所由一个骗子经营，而他的资历从没人想到去核实。

s.m: 意识形态倡导者，思想家
s.en: The committee needed an administrator and got an ideologue instead.
s.zh: 委员会需要的是一位管理者，来的却是一位意识形态倡导者。

s.en: Addition is commutative; subtraction, as any student soon discovers, is not.
s.zh: 加法是可交换的；而减法，任何学生很快就会发现，并非如此。

s.en: Three good quarters made the board complacent about a market that was already shifting.
s.zh: 三个季度的好成绩让董事会变得自满的，而市场其实早已生变。

s.m: 缓和的，安抚的；安抚（mollify的现在分词）
s.en: A mollifying phone call from the director kept the dispute out of the press.
s.zh: 主管一通安抚的电话，让这场争执没有见诸报端。

s.en: The most insidious errors are the ones that make the data look cleaner.
s.zh: 最暗中危害的错误，是那些让数据显得更干净的错误。

s.en: There is a sly joke buried in the appendix that most readers miss entirely.
s.zh: 附录里埋着一个狡猾的玩笑，多数读者完全没有察觉。

s.m: 零星的，分散的，不定时发生的
s.en: Sporadic outages continued for a month before the faulty relay was found.
s.zh: 零星的断电持续了一个月，故障继电器才被找到。

s.m: 遗忘的，健忘的，不注意的
s.en: Absorbed in the manuscript, she was oblivious to the room emptying around her.
s.zh: 她埋首于手稿，对周围渐渐空掉的房间毫不注意的。

s.m: 跳动的，阵痛的；脉搏，跳动
s.en: A throbbing headache made the last hour of the flight nearly intolerable.
s.zh: 一阵跳动的头痛，让飞行的最后一小时几乎难以忍受。

s.en: The ceremony required an obeisance that visiting officials found difficult to perform.
s.zh: 仪式要求行一个鞠躬礼，来访官员觉得很难做到。

s.en: The decline in shipping is secular rather than cyclical, and no recovery will reverse it.
s.zh: 航运的衰退是长期的而非周期性的，任何复苏都无法逆转。

s.m: 血管的，脉管的，有维管束的
s.en: Vascular plants dominate the site, having crowded out the mosses within a decade.
s.zh: 有维管束的植物主导了这片区域，十年内便挤走了苔藓。

s.en: The storm pummeled the coast for two days before turning out to sea.
s.zh: 风暴狠揍了海岸两天，才转向外海。

s.en: Missing metadata impedes reuse far more than any restriction on copyright does.
s.zh: 元数据缺失对再利用的阻碍，远甚于任何版权限制。

s.m: 泄密者，迹象；泄密的，能说明问题的
s.en: The telltale gap in the ledger appeared in the same week every year.
s.zh: 账本上那处能说明问题的缺口，每年都出现在同一周。

s.en: The letters evince an anxiety about money that his public writing never admits.
s.zh: 这些信件流露出一种对金钱的焦虑，而他公开的文字从不承认。

s.en: A skilled interviewer can educe from a reluctant witness what direct questioning cannot.
s.zh: 熟练的访谈者能从不情愿的证人那里引出直接盘问得不到的东西。

s.en: From the pattern of wear we can deduce which door the household actually used.
s.zh: 从磨损的分布我们可以推断，这家人实际使用的是哪扇门。

s.en: Nothing in the contract could induce her to sign away the rights to her own data.
s.zh: 合同里没有任何条件能引诱她签字放弃自己数据的权利。

s.en: He adduced three cases in support of a rule that turned out to have four exceptions.
s.zh: 他引证了三个案例来支持一条规则，而这条规则后来被发现有四个例外。

s.en: Traders carried myrrh along the same routes that later moved silk and paper.
s.zh: 商人沿着后来运送丝绸与纸张的同一批路线运送没药。

s.m: 子午线，经线，顶点；顶点的
s.en: Every longitude is measured from a meridian that was chosen by agreement, not by nature.
s.zh: 一切经度都以一条经线为起点计量，而这条线出自约定而非自然。

s.en: She agreed to forgo a year's salary in exchange for uninterrupted research time.
s.zh: 她同意放弃一年薪水，换取不受打扰的研究时间。

s.m: 诙谐的，爱开玩笑的，滑稽的
s.en: His facetious aside was quoted without its context and read as an admission.
s.zh: 他一句诙谐的插话被脱离语境引用，被当成了承认。

s.en: The 1970s memo now looks prescient, though at the time it was filed and forgotten.
s.zh: 这份七十年代的备忘录如今看来是有先见之明的，尽管当时归档即被遗忘。

s.m: 浪费的，目光短浅的，无远见的
s.en: An improvident harvest policy left the region without seed for the following spring.
s.zh: 一项无远见的收成政策，使该地区来年春天无种可播。

s.en: The team squandered a two-year lead by refusing to publish anything provisional.
s.zh: 这支团队因拒绝发表任何阶段性成果，浪费了两年的领先。

s.en: He wrote of the 1950s as halcyon days, omitting everything that complicated the picture.
s.zh: 他把五十年代写成宁静的岁月，略去了一切使画面复杂的东西。

s.en: The speaker's somnolent delivery emptied half the hall before the intermission.
s.zh: 演讲者催眠的语调，在中场休息前就清空了半个礼堂。

s.en: A surly reply to a routine question told the reporters more than the press release did.
s.zh: 对一个常规问题粗暴的回答，透露给记者的东西比新闻稿还多。

s.m: 神秘莫测的，难以理解的
s.en: The committee's reasoning remained inscrutable even to those who had sat through it.
s.zh: 委员会的推理，即便对全程旁听的人也依旧难以理解的。

s.en: Her equable disposition made her the natural choice to chair a fractious panel.
s.zh: 她平和的性情，使她成为主持一个难缠专家组的自然人选。

s.m: 卑躬屈膝的，可怜的，悲惨的
s.en: The apology was abject enough to satisfy the board and too abject to restore his standing.
s.zh: 这份道歉卑躬屈膝的程度足以让董事会满意，却也卑微得无法挽回他的地位。

s.en: The upheaval of 1848 reshaped borders that had stood for two centuries.
s.zh: 一八四八年的大动荡，重塑了已存续两个世纪的边界。

s.en: Three reorganizations in four years produced constant upheaval and very little change.
s.zh: 四年三次重组，造成了持续的剧变，实质变化却极少。

s.en: With interest rates falling, the moment seemed propitious for the expansion.
s.zh: 利率下行，这个时机对扩张显得十分有利的。

s.m: 弹回的，有弹性的，能迅速恢复的
s.en: The local economy proved more resilient than any of the forecasts had allowed.
s.zh: 当地经济被证明比所有预测所设想的都更能迅速恢复的。

s.en: Of the fifty pages submitted, perhaps four were pertinent to the question before the court.
s.zh: 提交的五十页里，或许只有四页与法庭面前的问题是相关的。

s.m: 尖锐的，辛辣的，切中要害的，伤心的
s.en: The most poignant detail in the exhibit is a child's unfinished school notebook.
s.zh: 展览中最伤心的一处细节，是一本孩子未写完的练习簿。

s.en: The exchange grew so vitriolic that the journal closed the comment thread.
s.zh: 这场争论变得如此刻薄的，期刊索性关闭了评论区。

s.en: Applications spurted after the deadline was extended, then fell back just as sharply.
s.zh: 截止日期延后之后申请量激增，随后又同样急剧地回落。

s.en: The memoir treats illness as an affliction to be described rather than a lesson to be drawn.
s.zh: 这本回忆录把疾病当作一种需要描述的苦难，而非可供提炼的教训。

s.en: The 1998 standard supersedes every earlier version, though many labs still cite the old one.
s.zh: 一九九八年的标准取代了此前所有版本，尽管许多实验室仍引用旧版。

s.en: Frankincense was once worth more by weight than the gold it was offered alongside.
s.zh: 乳香曾经论重量比与之一同进献的黄金还要贵重。

s.en: The report found the contractor culpable but stopped short of recommending prosecution.
s.zh: 报告认定承包商是该受谴责的，但没有建议提起公诉。

s.en: What could have been a dry procedural account is instead enthralling.
s.zh: 本可能枯燥的程序性叙述，反倒引人入胜的。

s.en: Her felicitous choice of title did more for the book's sales than any review.
s.zh: 她恰当的书名选择，对销量的贡献超过任何一篇书评。

s.en: He returned from the survey gaunt, having lived six weeks on field rations.
s.zh: 他从勘察归来时形容憔悴的，靠野外口粮过了六周。

s.en: The company vaunted its safety record until an internal audit contradicted it.
s.zh: 公司一直吹嘘自己的安全记录，直到一次内部审计与之相悖。

s.en: The museum agreed to restitution of the bronzes after a decade of negotiation.
s.zh: 经过十年谈判，博物馆同意归还这些青铜器。

s.en: She found solace in the archive's routine when nothing else in the year held still.
s.zh: 当那一年别无一物安定时，她在档案工作的规律中找到了慰藉。

s.en: The committee retains a vestigial veto that it has not used since 1974.
s.zh: 该委员会保留着一项残留的否决权，自一九七四年以来从未行使。

s.en: The ceremony was somber, as befitted an anniversary no one wished to celebrate.
s.zh: 仪式是忧郁的，正合乎一个无人愿意庆祝的周年。

s.m: 坚忍的，禁欲的；坚忍克己的人
s.en: His stoic account of the ordeal omits the detail that he had been injured throughout.
s.zh: 他对这场磨难坚忍的叙述，略去了自己全程带伤的细节。

s.m: 不满的，愤恨的；使疏远（disaffect的过去式）
s.en: A handful of disaffected members founded the rival society within the year.
s.zh: 少数不满的成员在当年就创立了与之抗衡的学会。

s.en: Her unstinting praise for a junior colleague's work changed the course of his career.
s.zh: 她对一位年轻同事工作毫无保留的赞扬，改变了他的职业轨迹。

s.en: An evenhanded account would have quoted the dissenting engineers as well.
s.zh: 一份不偏不倚的记述，本该也引述持异议的工程师。

s.en: The unadorned prose suits a subject that would collapse under any embellishment.
s.zh: 这种朴素的文字，恰好适合一个经不起任何修饰的题材。

s.m: 任性的，任性的，反复无常的
s.d: 任性的，难以驾驭的，反复无常的
s.en: The novel follows a wayward heir who squanders three fortunes in as many decades.
s.zh: 小说讲述一个任性的继承人，在三十年间挥霍掉三笔家产。

s.m: 不可思议的，难以置信的
s.en: It seemed inconceivable in 1990 that the entire archive would one day fit on a single disk.
s.zh: 在一九九〇年，整个档案有朝一日能装进一张磁盘，似乎是不可思议的。

s.en: The veneration accorded the founder made honest assessment of his work nearly impossible.
s.zh: 人们对创始人的崇拜，使得对其成果的诚实评价几乎不可能。

s.m: 重弹老调，改头换面地重复；翻版
s.en: The sequel is a rehash of the original with a larger budget and fewer ideas.
s.zh: 续集不过是原作的翻版，预算更大，想法更少。

s.en: The pilot reported vertigo in the cloud layer, where the horizon disappeared entirely.
s.zh: 飞行员报告在云层中出现眩晕，那里地平线完全消失。

s.en: Two senior officials were implicated in the scheme, though neither was ever charged.
s.zh: 两名高级官员与这一计划有牵连，尽管二人都未被起诉。

s.en: She was famously discreet about her sources, even when pressed by her own editors.
s.zh: 她对消息来源出了名地谨慎的，即便被自家编辑追问也不松口。

s.en: He remained the nominal head of the project while others made every decision.
s.zh: 他仍是项目名义上的负责人，而所有决定都由别人做出。

s.en: Readers take a vicarious pleasure in risks they would never accept themselves.
s.zh: 读者从自己绝不会承担的冒险中，获得一种间接体验的快感。

s.m: 怠惰的，无精打采的，令人倦怠的
s.en: The film's languorous pacing rewards patience and punishes everything else.
s.zh: 影片令人倦怠的节奏，奖赏耐心，而惩罚其余一切。

s.en: The adulatory profile reads as though it had been written by the subject's own office.
s.zh: 这篇奉承的人物特稿，读起来像是传主自己办公室写的。

s.en: His vituperative response cost him the support of colleagues who had agreed with him.
s.zh: 他谩骂的回应，令原本赞同他的同事也不再支持。

s.en: Attempts to repress the pamphlets only multiplied the number in circulation.
s.zh: 试图压制这些小册子，反而让流通的数量成倍增加。

s.en: The drift was imperceptible month to month and unmistakable across a decade.
s.zh: 这种漂移逐月看是察觉不到的，跨越十年却无可否认。

s.m: 上升的，占优势的；优势，运星
s.en: For a decade the quantitative school was ascendant, and other approaches went unfunded.
s.zh: 有十年之久，量化学派是占优势的，其他路径都得不到资助。

s.en: The same editorial that decried the tactic had praised it two years earlier.
s.zh: 同一家社论谴责这一手法，两年前却曾为之叫好。

s.en: Whale blubber lit the streets of European cities for the better part of a century.
s.zh: 鲸脂照亮了欧洲城市的街道，前后近一个世纪。

s.en: The footnotes are erudite to the point of intimidating the general reader.
s.zh: 这些脚注博学的程度，足以让普通读者望而生畏。

s.en: He was treated as a savant on a subject he had studied for only two years.
s.zh: 在一个他只研究了两年的题目上，他被当作专家看待。

s.m: 初级律师，事务律师，征求者
s.en: Her solicitor advised settling before the matter ever reached a barrister.
s.zh: 她的事务律师建议在案子交到出庭律师手上之前就和解。

s.en: He was solicitous of the graduate students in a way senior faculty rarely were.
s.zh: 他对研究生的关心的态度，是资深教员少有的。

s.en: Her letters show a solicitude for her students that her lectures never revealed.
s.zh: 她的书信显示出对学生的关怀，这是她的课堂从未流露的。

s.en: The walkout succeeded because solidarity held across three separate bargaining units.
s.zh: 这次罢工成功，是因为三个独立谈判单位之间的团结没有瓦解。

s.en: What the government called an insurrection the local press described as a tax revolt.
s.zh: 政府称之为叛乱的事件，当地报纸描述为一场抗税。

s.en: In the tumult that followed the announcement, no one heard the chair adjourn the meeting.
s.zh: 公告之后的骚动中，没人听见主席宣布散会。

s.en: The pamphlet's inflammatory language was quoted at trial as evidence of intent.
s.zh: 这份小册子煽动性的措辞，在庭上被引作意图的证据。

s.en: The merger occasioned a review of every contract the two firms had signed.
s.zh: 这次合并引起了对两家公司已签署的每一份合同的审查。

s.m: 沉着的，冷静的，不易激动的
s.en: Imperturbable under cross-examination, she answered each question in the same level tone.
s.zh: 在交叉盘问中她始终沉着的，用同样平稳的语气回答每个问题。

s.m: 愤世嫉俗的，冷嘲热讽的
s.en: It would be cynical to assume the donation had no motive beyond publicity.
s.zh: 若断定这笔捐款除了博取曝光别无动机，未免过于愤世嫉俗的。

s.en: In retrospect, the warning signs were spread across four unrelated reports.
s.zh: 回顾起来，那些警示信号分散在四份互不相关的报告里。

s.en: The forecast was dire, but the measures it prompted made it wrong.
s.zh: 那份预测是可怕的，但它促成的措施反而让它落了空。

s.en: The department spent two years in turmoil before a permanent chair was appointed.
s.zh: 在常任系主任获任命之前，该系在动荡中度过了两年。

s.en: Historians should not indulge in speculation the documents cannot support.
s.zh: 史学家不该沉溺于文献无法支撑的臆测。

s.en: What sounded like harmless banter read very differently once it was transcribed.
s.zh: 听上去无害的打趣，一旦被誊写成文字，读起来就大不相同。

s.en: The suit alleged libel, though the disputed sentence appeared only in an early draft.
s.zh: 诉讼指控文字诽谤，尽管争议的那句话只出现在早期草稿中。

s.m: 瞎扯，喋喋不休；胡说八道
s.en: Twenty minutes of blather preceded the one sentence that actually answered the question.
s.zh: 在真正回答问题的那一句话之前，是二十分钟的瞎扯。

s.m: 一阵……（疾病、情绪、活动等发作）
s.en: A bout of influenza kept her from the conference where the results were announced.
s.zh: 一阵流感发作，使她错过了公布结果的那场会议。

s.en: The province's recalcitrance delayed the census by nearly two years.
s.zh: 该省的不服从，使人口普查推迟了将近两年。

s.m: 虚假的，伪造的，欺骗性的
s.en: The correlation is spurious: both series simply rise with population.
s.zh: 这一相关性是虚假的：两组数据不过都随人口增长而上升。

s.m: 使气恼，怨恨；触怒人的事物
s.en: It peeved him that the earlier study was cited and his own never was.
s.zh: 早先那项研究总被引用而他自己的从未被提及，这使他很气恼。

s.en: A published timeline did more to assuage public anger than any apology had.
s.zh: 一份公开的时间线，比任何道歉都更能平息公众的愤怒。

s.en: The prospectus beguiled investors with projections that assumed no competition at all.
s.zh: 招股书用完全不考虑竞争的预测，欺骗了投资者。

s.m: 使困惑，使不知所措；困惑
s.en: The question nonplussed a witness who had rehearsed answers to everything else.
s.zh: 这个问题使一位早已把别的答案都演练过的证人不知所措。

s.en: The wage covers subsistence and nothing that could be called a life.
s.zh: 这份工资只够维持生存，谈不上任何像样的生活。

s.en: The court dismissed the suit as frivolous and ordered the plaintiff to pay costs.
s.zh: 法院以诉讼琐碎的为由驳回，并判原告承担费用。

s.en: A timely warning from a night technician prevented the entire batch from being lost.
s.zh: 一名夜班技术员及时的警告，避免了整批样品报废。

s.en: It is gratifying to see a method dismissed for years finally adopted as standard.
s.zh: 看到一种被冷落多年的方法终于成为标准，是令人满意的。

s.en: Cataloguing the collection proved more arduous than acquiring it had been.
s.zh: 为这批藏品编目，比当初收购它还要艰巨的。

s.en: Two months of indecision cost more than either of the options under discussion.
s.zh: 两个月的犹豫不决，代价高过所讨论的任何一个选项。

s.m: 浮力，（经济）繁荣，乐观的精神
s.en: The hull's buoyancy was calculated for cargo half the weight it eventually carried.
s.zh: 船体的浮力，是按最终载货重量一半来计算的。

s.m: 浮力，乐观的精神，（经济）繁荣
s.en: Her buoyancy survived three rejections and a lost grant.
s.zh: 经历三次退稿和一次资助落空，她乐观的精神依然未减。

s.en: The report describes the plight of families the relief formula had simply omitted.
s.zh: 报告描述了那些被救助公式直接漏掉的家庭的困境。

s.en: Nothing in the statistics conveys the plight of a single household in that district.
s.zh: 统计数字丝毫传达不出那个区里任何一户人家的境况。

s.en: In the older sense, to plight one's word was to bind oneself past any retreat.
s.zh: 在更古的用法里，立下誓约意味着让自己再无退路。

s.en: The insect's mimetic coloring makes it nearly invisible against dead leaves.
s.zh: 这种昆虫拟态的体色，让它在枯叶间几乎无法被发现。

s.en: His querulous letters to the editor eventually became a column of their own.
s.zh: 他那些抱怨的读者来信，最终自成了一个专栏。

s.en: All findings are subject to revision once the second cohort is analyzed.
s.zh: 一旦第二组队列完成分析，所有结论都取决于修订结果。

s.en: She was captivated by a problem her supervisor considered a dead end.
s.zh: 她被一个导师认为是死胡同的问题迷住了。

s.en: Everything after the second paragraph is conjecture dressed as chronology.
s.zh: 第二段之后的一切，都是打扮成年表的推测。

s.en: The proof rests on an axiom that later mathematicians declined to accept.
s.zh: 这个证明建立在一条后世数学家不肯接受的公理之上。

s.en: What looked like a fad in 2005 is now the default architecture of the field.
s.zh: 二〇〇五年看似一时的时尚，如今已是该领域的默认架构。

s.m: 证明信，推荐信，奖状；表彰的
s.en: The application arrived with four testimonials and no evidence of independent work.
s.zh: 申请材料附了四封推荐信，却没有独立工作的证据。

s.en: She handled the hostile questioning with an aplomb that impressed even her critics.
s.zh: 面对敌意的质询，她的沉着连批评者都为之折服。

s.m: 谨慎的，小心的，不显眼的
s.en: A discreet inquiry established the facts without alerting anyone in the department.
s.zh: 一次谨慎的问询查清了事实，而未惊动系里任何人。

s.en: The conclusion is trite, which is a pity in an essay otherwise full of surprises.
s.zh: 结论是陈腐的，这对一篇处处出人意料的文章来说很可惜。

s.en: He was prolific without being repetitive, which is rarer than either quality alone.
s.zh: 他多产的同时并不重复，这比两者中任何一样单独出现都更少见。

s.m: 争论的，辩论的，好争辩的
s.en: The book is polemical where it should be evidentiary, and loses the argument as a result.
s.zh: 这本书在本该举证之处却是好争辩的，因而输掉了论战。

s.en: The sedateness of the ceremony contrasted sharply with the turmoil outside.
s.zh: 仪式的严肃，与外面的动荡形成鲜明对照。

s.en: She pursued the appeal indomitably through four levels of the court system.
s.zh: 她不屈不挠地把上诉进行到底，穿过了四级法院。

s.en: The library exists because of one donor's munificence and a great deal of luck.
s.zh: 这座图书馆得以存在，靠的是一位捐赠者的慷慨和大量的运气。

s.en: Later programs tried to emulate the institute's model and reproduced only its budget.
s.zh: 后来的项目试图效仿该研究所的模式，结果只复制了它的预算。

s.en: The pamphlet catalogues the iniquity of a system it never proposes to replace.
s.zh: 这本小册子罗列了一套制度的不公正，却从未提出取而代之的方案。

s.en: Long usage had sanctified a practice that no rule had ever authorized.
s.zh: 长期沿用，使一项从未获规则授权的做法被神圣化了。

s.en: The garrison repulsed three assaults before reinforcements arrived at dawn.
s.zh: 在援军黎明抵达之前，守军击退了三次进攻。

s.en: The board was cognizant of the risk and approved the plan regardless.
s.zh: 董事会是晓得这一风险的，却仍然批准了方案。

s.en: Dogmatism in either direction makes the evidence harder to read honestly.
s.zh: 无论倒向哪一边，教条主义都会让证据更难被诚实解读。

s.en: He vowed never to publish again, and broke the vow within eighteen months.
s.zh: 他发誓不再发表任何东西，十八个月内就违背了这个誓言。

s.en: The ministry proclaimed victory over the outbreak a week before cases rose again.
s.zh: 部里宣告战胜疫情，一周之后病例又开始上升。

s.en: The clause indemnifies the contractor against every claim except gross negligence.
s.zh: 该条款为承包商赔偿除重大过失外的一切索赔。

s.en: Vendors importuned the committee for months after the shortlist was published.
s.zh: 入围名单公布后的几个月里，供应商不断向委员会强求。

s.en: He described his training as education; his former colleagues call it indoctrination.
s.zh: 他把自己受的训练称为教育，而昔日同事称之为灌输。

s.m: 胆汁质的，坏脾气的，令人恶心的
s.en: A bilious review of a first novel can end a career before it starts.
s.zh: 一篇对处女作坏脾气的恶评，能在职业生涯开始前就将其终结。

s.en: The questions were demeaning in a way the transcript does not quite capture.
s.zh: 这些问题贬低人的程度，是文字记录难以完全传达的。

s.en: Only a pedant would object to the spelling while ignoring the argument.
s.zh: 只有迂腐的人才会揪着拼写不放，却对论证视而不见。

s.en: Supply shortages hobbled production for the better part of a year.
s.zh: 供应短缺阻碍了近一年的生产。

s.en: An emergency provision allowed the ministry to expedite approvals that normally took months.
s.zh: 一项紧急条款允许该部加快通常需要数月的审批。

s.en: The excavation was hampered by weather for six of its eight weeks.
s.zh: 这次发掘的八周里有六周受到天气的妨碍。

s.en: She remained ambivalent toward a prize that had ended better careers than it began.
s.zh: 她对这个奖项始终是持矛盾情绪的：它终结的职业生涯多过它成就的。

s.en: The gas was chosen for its inertness: it will not react with anything in the chamber.
s.zh: 选用这种气体正是看中它的惰性：它不会与腔内任何物质反应。

s.en: The board vacillated until the decision was effectively made by the calendar.
s.zh: 董事会一直犹豫不决，直到决定实际上是被日程替它做出的。

s.m: 轻率，言行失检，不谨慎的言行
s.en: A single indiscretion in an unguarded interview undid ten years of careful positioning.
s.zh: 一次访谈中放松警惕的言行失检，毁掉了十年的苦心经营。

s.en: The manual opens with an admonition that almost no one reads before the first failure.
s.zh: 手册开篇就是一则警告，而几乎无人在第一次故障前读过它。

s.en: The penalty for a first transgression is a letter; for a second, dismissal.
s.zh: 初次违背的处罚是一封信函，再犯则是解职。

s.m: 滑稽动作，古怪滑稽的行为（通常用复数）
s.en: His antics at the podium overshadowed a genuinely serious proposal.
s.zh: 他在讲台上的滑稽动作，盖过了一份确实严肃的提案。

s.m: 闹剧，闹剧效果；闹剧式的
s.en: The film's slapstick opening misleads audiences about how bleak it will become.
s.zh: 影片闹剧式的开场，误导了观众对其后来何等阴郁的预期。

s.en: Delivering that verdict to the family required more tact than legal skill.
s.zh: 把那个裁决告知家属，需要的老练多过法律技巧。

s.en: The letter reads as a supplication rather than the demand its author intended.
s.zh: 这封信读来像是恳求，而非作者本意中的要求。

s.en: The team tested every permutation of the four variables before finding the interaction.
s.zh: 团队测试了这四个变量的每一种排列，才找到那个交互作用。

s.m: 折磨，严酷考验，苦难经历
s.en: She described the appeal process as an ordeal designed to exhaust the applicant.
s.zh: 她把上诉过程形容为一场旨在拖垮申请人的严酷考验。

s.en: He had the good sense not to gloat when the rival theory collapsed.
s.zh: 对手的理论垮台时，他明智地没有幸灾乐祸。

s.en: The bibliography runs to sixty pages and is more useful than the text it supports.
s.zh: 参考书目长达六十页，比它所支撑的正文更有用。

s.m: 荒废的，快要倒塌 the 破旧的
s.d: 荒废的，快要倒塌的，破旧的
s.en: The society bought the dilapidated mill and spent a decade making it safe.
s.zh: 学会买下这座荒废的磨坊，花了十年才让它变得安全。

s.en: Inspectors found squalid conditions the operator had certified as compliant.
s.zh: 检查人员发现了被经营者认证为合规的肮脏的条件。

s.en: The lecture series was meant to edify the public and mostly flattered the lecturers.
s.zh: 这一系列讲座本意是启迪公众，结果多半只是恭维了讲者。

s.m: 健谈的，滔滔不绝的，旋转的
s.en: Voluble on every subject but his own research, he deflected each question with an anecdote.
s.zh: 他对任何话题都滔滔不绝的，唯独避谈自己的研究，用轶事挡掉每个问题。

s.en: The letter is penitent in tone but concedes no specific error.
s.zh: 这封信的语气是悔过的，却没有承认任何具体错误。

s.en: The deadline was ludicrously short for work of that scale.
s.zh: 对这种规模的工作来说，期限短得荒唐地可笑。

s.en: The abstract states succinctly what the introduction takes four pages to obscure.
s.zh: 摘要简洁地说清了引言用四页篇幅弄含糊的东西。

s.en: A minor infraction of the protocol invalidated results that had taken a year to collect.
s.zh: 对试验方案的一次轻微犯规，作废了耗时一年收集的结果。

s.en: The trade in illicit antiquities follows the same routes as legal shipping.
s.zh: 非法的文物交易，走的是与合法航运相同的路线。

s.m: 君主，元首；至高无上的，独立自主的
s.en: The treaty limited what a sovereign state could do with a river it did not solely own.
s.zh: 该条约限制了一个独立自主的国家对并非独享的河流所能做的事。

s.m: 受污染的，受玷污的；污染（taint的过去式）
s.en: Evidence gathered without a warrant was tainted and excluded at trial.
s.zh: 未经搜查令取得的证据是受玷污的，在庭审中被排除。

s.en: The ministry's dilatory response turned a manageable outbreak into a crisis.
s.zh: 该部拖拉的应对，把一场本可控制的疫情变成了危机。

s.en: The hearing produced more grandstanding than testimony.
s.zh: 这场听证会产生的哗众取宠多过证词。

s.en: Senatorial courtesy has blocked more nominations than any formal rule.
s.zh: 参议员的礼让惯例，比任何成文规则都阻挡了更多提名。

s.m: 敌意的，有害的，不友好的
s.en: Conditions in the cave are inimical to almost every organism except one species of beetle.
s.zh: 洞中的条件，对除一种甲虫外几乎所有生物都是有害的。

s.en: It is a truism that correlation is not causation, and it is ignored constantly.
s.zh: 相关不等于因果是个老生常谈，却总是被人忽视。

s.en: The speech assembled every cliche about resilience without saying anything new.
s.zh: 这篇演讲把关于韧性的陈词滥调凑了个遍，却没说出任何新意。

s.m: 纪念品，引起回忆的东西
s.en: He kept the rejected proposal as a memento of the year everything nearly ended.
s.zh: 他留着那份被否决的提案，作为几乎一切都告终那年的纪念品。

s.en: The proverb survives in six languages, each version blaming a different party.
s.zh: 这句谚语在六种语言里流传，每个版本责怪的对象都不同。

s.en: The ebullience of the early meetings gave way to the grind of actual drafting.
s.zh: 早期会议的热情洋溢，让位给了实际起草的苦役。

s.en: Heat dissipation, not processing speed, set the ceiling on the design.
s.zh: 限制该设计上限的是热量消散，而非处理速度。

s.m: 沉迷酒色的，消散的；驱散（dissipate的过去式）
s.en: The biography treats his dissipated years as a phase rather than a character.
s.zh: 传记把他沉迷酒色的那些年当作一个阶段，而非一种品性。

s.m: 多种多样的，五花八门的
s.en: Her multifarious interests made her difficult to place in any single department.
s.zh: 她多种多样的兴趣，使她很难被归入任何一个系。

s.m: 耐火的，倔强的，难治疗的；耐火材料
s.en: The furnace lining is refractory enough to survive a thousand cycles.
s.zh: 炉衬足够耐火的，能经受一千次循环。

s.en: Assiduous note-taking over twenty years produced an index no software could have built.
s.zh: 二十年勤勉的笔记，造就了一份任何软件都做不出的索引。

s.en: He left a remunerative practice for a post that paid a third as much.
s.zh: 他离开了有利可图的执业，去了一个薪水只有三分之一的职位。

s.en: The essay is remembered for one epigram and forgotten for everything else.
s.zh: 这篇文章因一句警句被记住，其余部分则被遗忘。

s.en: The final chapter is less an argument than a meditation on what the evidence cannot settle.
s.zh: 末章与其说是论证，不如说是对证据无法定论之事的沉思。

s.m: 根深蒂固的，成癖的，积习难改的
s.en: An inveterate annotator, he left no library book unmarked.
s.zh: 他是个积习难改的批注者，没有一本借来的书未被他画过。

s.en: Her protege now chairs the department that once refused her a position.
s.zh: 她的门生如今主持着当年拒绝录用她的那个系。

s.en: He played the misanthrope in public and answered every student letter in private.
s.zh: 他在公开场合扮演厌世者，私下却回复每一封学生来信。

s.m: 杂乱无章的，闲逛的，蔓生的
s.en: A rambling introduction buries a thesis that is, in the end, quite sharp.
s.zh: 杂乱无章的引言，埋没了一个其实相当锋利的论点。

s.m: 冗长的，无休止的，无止境的
s.en: The interminable consultation outlasted two of the officials who commissioned it.
s.zh: 这场无休止的咨询，熬走了两位当初委托它的官员。

s.en: The documentary avoids sentimentality by letting the participants contradict each other.
s.zh: 这部纪录片让参与者彼此矛盾，从而避免了多愁善感。

s.en: His rectitude was never doubted, which made the accounting error harder to explain.
s.zh: 他的正直从未受到怀疑，这反而让那处账目差错更难解释。

s.en: The hall's opulence sits oddly beside the poverty the museum documents.
s.zh: 大厅的富丽堂皇，与博物馆所记录的贫困并置得十分怪异。

s.m: 多愁善感，无病呻吟，令人作呕
s.en: The score's mawkishness undercuts scenes that would be devastating in silence.
s.zh: 配乐的无病呻吟，削弱了那些若在静默中会摧枯拉朽的场面。

s.en: An honest acknowledgment proved more of a balm than any compensation.
s.zh: 一句诚实的承认，比任何补偿都更像一剂安慰物。

s.en: The audience sat enraptured through a piece most had expected to find impenetrable.
s.zh: 观众着迷的听完了一首多数人原以为会晦涩难懂的曲子。

s.m: 搞双面派的，奸诈的，双重的
s.en: The memos reveal a duplicitous strategy: reassure the regulator, warn the shareholders.
s.zh: 这些备忘录揭示了一套搞双面派的策略：安抚监管者，警告股东。

s.m: 未受伤害的，完好无损的
s.en: The archive emerged unscathed from a fire that destroyed the rest of the building.
s.zh: 一场烧毁了整栋楼其余部分的大火后，档案室完好无损的。

s.en: Conditions in the camp were abominable long before anyone was permitted to report them.
s.zh: 营地的条件在获准报道之前很久就已糟糕的不堪。

s.en: Her calm demeanor belied how close the project had come to collapse.
s.zh: 她镇静的神态掩饰了这个项目曾多么接近崩溃。

s.en: Looters defiled the site so thoroughly that its stratigraphy is now unreadable.
s.zh: 盗掘者把遗址玷污得如此彻底，其地层已无法辨读。

s.m: 显露情感的，公开流露的，论证的
s.en: He was never demonstrative, which colleagues mistook for indifference.
s.zh: 他从不显露情感的，同事们误以为那是冷漠。

s.en: For years the firm ignored the rule with impunity because no one was empowered to enforce it.
s.zh: 多年来该公司无视规则却免除惩罚，因为无人有权执行它。

s.en: The response was executed with a celerity no one had thought the agency capable of.
s.zh: 这次响应执行之快速，是没人想到该机构能做到的。

s.en: A plangent bell marked each hour of the vigil.
s.zh: 哀伤的钟声，标记着守夜的每一个钟点。

s.m: 绚丽的，过分装饰的，面色红润的
s.en: The florid dedication runs longer than the chapter it introduces.
s.zh: 那篇过分装饰的献词，比它所引出的章节还要长。

s.m: 乏味的，枯燥的，无味道的
s.en: An insipid summary cannot do justice to research this strange.
s.zh: 一份乏味的摘要，配不上如此奇异的研究。

s.en: The committee he kept citing turned out to be a figment of a single misread footnote.
s.zh: 他反复引用的那个委员会，原来是一处误读脚注臆造的事物。

s.m: 派生的，无创意的；派生词，衍生物
s.en: The design is derivative, borrowing from three buildings without improving on any.
s.zh: 这个设计是无创意的，借用了三座建筑，却没有一处改进。

s.en: The tremors presaged a collapse that engineers had predicted a decade earlier.
s.zh: 这些震动预示着一场工程师十年前就预测过的坍塌。

s.en: The frieze's relief is shallow enough that raking light is needed to read it.
s.zh: 这条饰带的浮雕很浅，需要斜射光才能辨读。

s.m: 露头（岩石露出地面）；露出
s.en: A single outcrop of limestone gave the survey its first date for the whole formation.
s.zh: 一处石灰岩露头，为整个地层给出了勘察的第一个年代。

s.en: Reviewers lambasted the second edition for repeating errors the first had been forgiven.
s.zh: 评论者严厉斥责第二版重复了第一版曾被原谅的错误。

s.en: He was eulogized as a reformer by the very institution he had spent his life criticizing.
s.zh: 他被自己毕生批评的那家机构颂扬为改革者。

s.en: The strain's virulence declined even as its transmissibility rose.
s.zh: 该毒株的毒性下降，传播力却在上升。

s.en: A five-year moratorium on drilling gave the review board time it never used.
s.zh: 为期五年的钻探暂停，给了评审委员会一段它从未利用的时间。

s.en: The proliferation of competing standards defeated the interoperability each promised.
s.zh: 竞争性标准的激增，击溃了每一种标准所承诺的互操作性。

s.m: 临时的，暂时的；临时人员
s.en: The provisional figures were treated as final by everyone except the statisticians.
s.zh: 除统计人员外，所有人都把这些临时的数字当作最终数据。

s.m: 帝国的，皇帝的，至高无上的
s.en: The imperial road system outlasted the administration that built it by a thousand years.
s.zh: 这套帝国的道路系统，比修建它的官僚体系多存续了一千年。

s.m: （尤指青少年的）犯罪，违法行为，失职
s.en: The study links delinquency less to poverty than to the absence of anything to do.
s.zh: 该研究把青少年犯罪更多地归因于无事可做，而非贫困。

s.en: The exuberance of the first draft is what the editors spent a year removing.
s.zh: 初稿中那股充沛的活力，正是编辑们花了一年时间删掉的东西。

s.en: An acrimonious split left two rival journals covering the same narrow field.
s.zh: 一场刻薄的决裂，留下两份彼此对立的期刊，报道同一个狭窄领域。

s.en: The model is beguiling precisely because it explains the past so neatly.
s.zh: 这个模型之所以迷人的，恰恰因为它把过去解释得太过整齐。

s.en: No one questioned the witness's veracity, only her memory.
s.zh: 无人质疑证人的诚实，只质疑她的记忆。

s.en: He digressed for twenty minutes and returned to a point no one still remembered.
s.zh: 他离题了二十分钟，回到了一个已无人记得的论点上。

s.en: Doubts assailed her only after the paper had already gone to press.
s.zh: 直到论文付印之后，疑虑才开始困扰她。

s.m: 实质性的，独立存在的；名词
s.en: The revision is cosmetic; not one substantive objection has been addressed.
s.zh: 这次修订只是表面功夫，没有一条实质性的反对意见得到回应。

s.en: The argument is recondite but not obscure: it rewards the reader who slows down.
s.zh: 这一论证是深奥的，却并不含糊：它奖赏放慢速度的读者。

s.m: 普通马，出租马车；雇佣；陈腐的
s.en: Before the taxi, a hackney waited at every station in the city.
s.zh: 在出租车出现之前，城中每个车站都停着出租马车。

s.en: By March the department had regained some semblance of order.
s.zh: 到了三月，这个系恢复了某种秩序的外表。

s.en: The letters are valuable precisely because they contain no dissemblance whatever.
s.zh: 这些书信之所以珍贵，正因为其中毫无掩饰。

s.en: Fieldwork is rarely as glamorously portrayed as the documentaries suggest.
s.zh: 野外工作很少像纪录片所暗示的那样被迷人地呈现。

s.m: 创始人；（船）沉没，（计划）失败，变跛
s.en: The merger foundered on a disagreement neither side had thought material.
s.zh: 这桩并购最终失败，起因是双方都不曾视为要害的一处分歧。

s.en: A witty title has rescued more mediocre papers than good data ever has.
s.zh: 一个机智的标题拯救过的平庸论文，比优质数据拯救过的还多。

s.en: Asked to recollect the meeting, three participants gave three incompatible accounts.
s.zh: 被要求回忆那场会议时，三位与会者给出了三种互不相容的说法。

s.en: The claim that subliminal images drive purchasing has never survived replication.
s.zh: 潜意识的图像会驱动购买这一说法，从未经受住重复实验。

s.m: 使人发呆的，惊人的；使麻木
s.en: The scale of the archive is stupefying: eleven million items, none catalogued.
s.zh: 这座档案的规模惊人的：一千一百万件，无一编目。

s.en: His treatise on tides was ignored for forty years and then reprinted twice in one decade.
s.zh: 他关于潮汐的专著被忽视了四十年，随后十年内重印两次。

s.m: 奢侈逸乐的，感官享受的，（体态）丰满迷人的
s.en: The paintings' voluptuous surfaces were criticized by contemporaries as mere display.
s.zh: 这些画作感官享受的表面，被同时代人批评为徒有炫技。

s.m: 羞怯的，局促不安的，像绵羊一样的
s.en: He gave a sheepish account of how the samples had been mislabeled.
s.zh: 他局促不安的说明了样本是如何被贴错标签的。

s.en: The poem's sensuous detail does the work that its argument never attempts.
s.zh: 这首诗感官的细节，完成了它的论说从未尝试的工作。

s.en: The translator's diction is modern, which the introduction defends at length.
s.zh: 译者的措辞是现代的，引言对此作了长篇辩护。

s.en: Reviewers are permitted to indulge one joke per review, and he used his early.
s.zh: 评论者每篇书评容许放纵一个玩笑，而他早早就用掉了。

s.m: 麻木的，迟钝的，不活泼的
s.en: The colony grows torpid below ten degrees and resumes activity within an hour of warming.
s.zh: 低于十度时，这个群落变得不活泼的，回暖一小时内便恢复活动。

s.en: Estivation lets the snail survive months in which no moisture reaches the surface.
s.zh: 夏眠让这种蜗牛熬过地表数月得不到水分的时期。

s.en: Her ingenuous question exposed an assumption the whole panel had been avoiding.
s.zh: 她天真的提问，揭穿了整个专家组一直回避的一个假设。

s.m: 做作的，戏剧的；演员，装腔作势的人
s.en: His histrionic resignation speech was quoted for weeks and believed by no one.
s.zh: 他做作的辞职演说被引用了数周，却无人相信。

s.en: Temperament, not training, decided which of them could sit through the tedium.
s.zh: 决定他们谁能熬过这种枯燥的是性情，而非训练。

s.en: The statute leaves so much to official discretion that two counties reached opposite results.
s.zh: 该法规把太多事情留给官员自行决定权，以致两个县得出相反的结果。

s.en: Rapacious harvesting emptied the bay within a single generation.
s.zh: 掠夺的捕捞，在一代人之内就掏空了这片海湾。

s.en: A surreptitious recording, made without consent, became the case's central exhibit.
s.zh: 一段未经同意秘密的录音，成了此案的核心证物。

s.en: The diminutive engine produced more power than machines twice its size.
s.zh: 这台极小的发动机，输出的功率超过体积两倍于它的机器。

s.en: When the slides failed he extemporized for forty minutes without repeating himself.
s.zh: 幻灯片出故障时，他即席发言四十分钟而不重复。

s.en: She expounds the theory clearly and then spends the rest of the book qualifying it.
s.zh: 她清楚地详细阐述了该理论，然后用全书其余篇幅为它加限定。

s.en: Two colleagues expostulated with him privately before anyone raised the matter formally.
s.zh: 在有人正式提出此事之前，两位同事已私下规劝过他。

s.en: He ruminated on the objection for a month and then rewrote the chapter entirely.
s.zh: 他就那条反对意见沉思了一个月，然后把整章重写了。

s.m: 倾斜，（失控地）疾驶；船只倾侧
s.en: The cart careened down the slope and stopped only against the wall of the barn.
s.zh: 手推车失控地疾驶下坡，直到撞上谷仓的墙才停住。

s.en: The report arrived bristling with qualifications that made its finding nearly unusable.
s.zh: 这份报告充满的限定条件，使其结论几乎无法使用。

s.en: What was billed as a consultation was a masquerade: the decision had already been signed.
s.zh: 号称咨询的东西不过是一场伪装：决定早已签署。

s.m: 死后的，事后的；尸体解剖，事后分析
s.en: The postmortem identified three separate failures, any one of which would have been survivable.
s.zh: 事后分析找出三处各自独立的失误，其中任何一处单独出现都不致命。

s.m: 死后的，身后发表的，遗腹的
s.en: The posthumous edition restores passages the author had been persuaded to cut.
s.zh: 这个身后发表的版本，恢复了作者当年被劝删去的段落。

s.m: 根本原因，逻辑依据，合理性
s.en: The rationale for the exemption was never written down, which is why it survived so long.
s.zh: 这项豁免的逻辑依据从未落于纸面，这正是它长期存续的原因。

s.en: The final section is a recapitulation rather than a conclusion, and the reader notices.
s.zh: 最后一节是扼要重述而非结论，读者是看得出来的。

s.en: The discovery caused a sensation in the press and almost none in the field itself.
s.zh: 这一发现在媒体上引起轰动，在业内却几乎无人在意。

s.en: Contemporaries derided the design; it is now on the currency.
s.zh: 同时代人嘲笑这个设计，如今它印在了货币上。

s.en: Publication was contingent on the sponsor's approval, a condition disclosed only later.
s.zh: 发表取决于赞助方的批准，而这一条件后来才被披露。

s.m: 视情况而定的，偶然的；代表团，分遣队
s.en: A contingent of forty observers arrived a week before the vote.
s.zh: 一支四十人的代表团在投票前一周抵达。

s.m: 构造的，地壳构造的，建筑的
s.en: Tectonic movement raised the range faster than erosion could wear it down.
s.zh: 地壳构造的运动抬升山脉的速度，快过侵蚀将其削平的速度。

s.en: Instruments must be sterilized between procedures, a rule the audit found routinely ignored.
s.zh: 器械必须在两次手术之间消毒，而审计发现这条规则被常规性无视。

s.en: The obliquity of the earth's axis, not its distance from the sun, produces the seasons.
s.zh: 造成四季的是地轴的倾斜，而非地球与太阳的距离。

s.m: 错误，缺点，断层；挑剔，犯错
s.en: Movement along the fault has been measured at two centimetres a year.
s.zh: 沿该断层的位移，实测为每年两厘米。

s.en: The shortage is a manifestation of a policy adopted twenty years earlier.
s.zh: 这次短缺，是二十年前采纳的一项政策的表现。

s.en: Quiet disaffection among the staff surfaced only when the survey was made anonymous.
s.zh: 员工中沉默的不满，直到调查改为匿名才浮出水面。

s.en: Severity falls along a continuum, which is why any threshold will be somewhat arbitrary.
s.zh: 严重程度落在一个连续统一体上，所以任何阈值都难免有些武断。

s.m: 坚韧不拔的，多沙的，生动逼真的
s.en: A gritty determination, not talent, carried her through the first three years.
s.zh: 支撑她度过头三年的是坚韧不拔的决心，而非天赋。

s.en: His allegiance was to the method rather than to any school that claimed it.
s.zh: 他的忠诚属于方法本身，而非任何宣称拥有它的学派。

s.en: Two former directors endorsed the proposal; the sitting board rejected it anyway.
s.zh: 两位前任主管支持该提案，现任董事会仍予以否决。

s.en: A decade of negotiation culminated in an agreement that lasted eleven months.
s.zh: 十年谈判以一份仅维持了十一个月的协议告终。

s.en: Readers misconstrued the footnote as a concession when it was meant as a warning.
s.zh: 读者把那条脚注误解为让步，其实它本意是警告。

s.en: The leaked photograph galvanized a public that petitions had failed to move.
s.zh: 那张外泄的照片，激起了请愿书未能打动的公众。

s.en: The modesty of his claims is what makes the evidence so persuasive.
s.zh: 他主张的谦虚，正是证据如此有说服力的原因。

s.en: He affected an indifference that his notebooks flatly contradict.
s.zh: 他假装出一种冷漠，而他的笔记本对此断然否认。

s.m: 被免职的，被废黜的；免职
s.en: The deposed director published his account of the affair within the year.
s.zh: 这位被免职的主管当年就发表了他对此事的说法。

s.m: 背叛的，危险的，不可靠的
s.en: The passage is treacherous in winter and merely difficult the rest of the year.
s.zh: 这条通道在冬季是危险的，一年中其余时候仅仅是难走。

s.m: 坦率，直率，诚挚（英式拼写）
s.en: The interview is valuable for its candour about failures the field prefers to forget.
s.zh: 这篇访谈的价值，在于它对该领域宁愿遗忘的失败所持的坦率。

s.en: The older convention still prevails in three of the four subfields.
s.zh: 在四个分支学科中的三个里，旧惯例仍然盛行。

s.en: The wear on the threshold attests to centuries of daily use.
s.zh: 门槛上的磨损，证实了数百年的日常使用。

s.m: 拙劣的模仿，恶搞作品；模仿开涮
s.en: What began as parody was reprinted so often that readers took it for the original.
s.zh: 起初是拙劣的模仿，因重印太多，读者反把它当成了原作。

s.en: The estate consisted of corporeal property only; the copyrights went elsewhere.
s.zh: 这份遗产只包含有形的财产，版权归了别处。

s.m: 顾忌，良心上的不安；顾虑
s.en: He had no scruple about publishing data he had not gathered himself.
s.zh: 对于发表并非自己采集的数据，他毫无顾忌。

s.en: The repair shows real ingenuity: two spare parts and a length of wire.
s.zh: 这处修补显示出真正的独创性：两个备件加一段电线。

s.m: 心灵手巧的，精明的，设计独特的
s.en: An ingenious control eliminated the confound that had ruined the earlier trial.
s.zh: 一个设计独特的对照，消除了毁掉先前试验的那个混杂因素。

s.en: Her ingenuousness in the interview was mistaken for naivety by people who should have known better.
s.zh: 她在访谈中的天真率直，被本该更明白的人误认作幼稚。

s.m: 纪念的；纪念币/邮票（注：图中漏了e）
s.d: 纪念的；纪念币／纪念邮票
s.en: A commemorative issue marked the centenary, though the event it honored had been largely forgotten.
s.zh: 一枚纪念的发行品标志着百年诞辰，尽管它所纪念的事件早已大半被遗忘。
